Hello, welcome to Voat!

You find yourself in a dimly lit room. The only light filters in from a crack in the roof and running part way down the west wall. Formless debris litters the floor, the walls appear blackened as if by fire. Tattered and burned wall hangings sway gently, moved by a cold and putrid smelling breeze emanating from a dark passage at the far side of the chamber. You hear a series of echoing metallic clicks as hidden tumblers fall into place...

What would you like to do?
Post the wizard calmly sits. He has prepared for the kind of moment all through training. He prepares a hold person spell to catch the intruder off guard and make a dashing escape.

You sit patiently, waiting for something to change within the room. The floor is dank and chills you to the bone. Slowly, you become aware of a deep vibration as if some arcane machinery has been put into motion by your presence. The vibration grows in both intensity and audibility. Your ears soon ring from the infernal din. You are finding it increasingly difficult to think. To focus.

Make an intelligence check.

It begins to dawn on you that the spell you prepared will not avail you. Nobody is coming, at least nothing alive. As the thought solidifies in your mind, the walls begin to fall away and the roof collapses. Fortunately, none of the larger sections strike you, however you are pelted by smaller pieces. It is painful to be sure, but does no real damage.

You expect to see the lands surrounding the tower you entered only an hour or so earlier. You are sorely disappointed. What you do see is part of no land that you have ever heard tell of.

You come to realize that you very nearly lost your mind. Not because of the experience, but because something was trying desperately to wrest it away from you. It was only through your indomitable will that you maintained your senses.

With the walls and ceiling gone, you have a clear view of the strange world around you. Nothing matches any pattern you have ever imagined. The colors are wrong. The shapes are wrong. Even the very air is just... wrong.

You have but a moment to ponder what it all means when a shadow falls upon you from above. You hear the slow, steady beat of what could only be vast wings. You hear the unmistakable sound of metal on metal and the creak of leather.

To be continued...
